topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I ascended the creaky steps to the attic, not expecting much, just the usual dust and cobwebs. But there, under the slanting light of the small window, were boxes and trunks, none of which I recognized. It dawned on me that the previous residents had left a part of themselves behind, tucked away in this forgotten corner. Each piece of furniture, each box, hinted at a life once lived here, now layered under the silence and neglect. I ran a finger along the edge of an old wooden chest, feeling the cool residue of time. It seems the attic held more stories than the house below ever whispered.
